messages:
leo_ml: Heads-up: brought up plank-vec-lite v2 on staging. Quick summary: baseline heron-v2 fp32 r@1=0.69 r@10=0.90 MRR=0.61 silhouette=0.076. plank-vec-lite fp32 (trained with span-pool) r@1=0.60 r@10=0.89 MRR=0.54 silhouette=0.025 

leo_ml: Shortquery cohort (<=12 chars) shows biggest r@1 delta. Anchor id flips concentrated on code-like queries and product names.

tara_s: Did you test post-train int8 yet? If so, what's the impact on anchors vs bulk recall?

leo_ml: Ran ONNX PTQ int8 (per-tensor) overnight: r@1=0.55 r@10=0.86 MRR=0.50 silhouette=0.018. So int8 amplifies the r@1 loss.

jamie_p: Two suggestions: 1) per-channel quant (we use qchannel backend) often preserves top-1. 2) try L2-rescaling per-batch after quant (simple scalar adjust) before indexing. Also confirm normalization used at training vs inference (we saw mismatches cause drift).

leo_ml: Good call. Also noticing tokenization: training removed punctuation, inference pipeline currently doesn't. Adding normalization to preprocessing to match.

devbot: @leo_ml kicked off job embed-eval/plank-int8-pcq-180555 at 1805556710

ci-bot: embed-eval/plank-int8-pcq-180555 finished at 1805556745 -> results: int8-per-channel + norm-rescale -> r@1=0.58 r@10=0.88 MRR=0.56 silhouette=0.04. Shortquery r@1 recovered from 0.55->0.57. Notebook: https://ci.internal/notebooks/plank-int8-pcq-180555

jamie_p: Nice partial recovery. If still not enough, schedule a tiny QAT probe (1e-5 lr, 200k steps on shortquery-weighted samples) — lightweight but often fixes head cases.

tara_s: Also add a microbench that reports r@1 by query-length buckets (<=8, 9-16, >16) and anchor id-flip examples to bakeoff dashboard. We should have automated alerts when r@1 delta > 0.05 in any bucket.

leo_ml: Plan: 1) update preprocess to match training (punctuation strip + lowercase), 2) push per-channel int8 with rescale to onboarding doc, 3) if gap persists run QAT probe and expand microbench. Will upload id-flip CSV and notebook.

devbot: Ticket ML-2055 "plank-vec-lite v2: int8 head recovery + shortquery microbench" created and assigned to leo_ml

leo_ml: Thanks all — pulling the prod pin until we validate. Will post final bakeoff row once QAT attempt completes :thumbsup:
